Subject: CAIQ intake — initial ask and timeline

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the intro over the phone earlier. Attached is Aurora Health's standard CAIQ intake (Aurora_CAIQ_Request.pdf) — it's a slightly pared-down questionnaire focused on controls around data residency, tenant segregation, and key management. We need a mapping back to Redwood's CAIQ responses plus sample evidence for these areas:

- Control set: CCM v4.0 sections A1 (Data Security), A2 (Identity & Access), C3 (Encryption & Key Mgmt)
- Examples requested: configuration screenshots (identity provider), key rotation log, runtime sample logs (redacted), policy PDF for data retention

Can you confirm:
1) A target submission date of next Wednesday (2026-03-18) works for you?
2) Preferred upload method (DocuSign/secure share/Drive link)?

If we can get the crosswalk and a small sample bundle (3–5 artifacts) by then, our auditors will be able to close the inquiry.

Thanks,
Megan

Hi Megan — really appreciate the clear brief and the PDF.

Short answer: we can get a CAIQ crosswalk and an evidence on-ramp ready by 2026-03-18 for the controls you listed, provided scope stays limited to our hosted API in the US region and the "production" tenant you referenced.

Planned next steps (our side):
- Karthik (security) will draft a mapping for the specific CCM sections you called out and list authoritative artifacts.
- Marissa (compliance ops) will stage the sample artifacts and provide a secure upload link.
- I'll provide a one-page narrative summarizing runtime isolation, key management, and retention windows.

Can you confirm the tenant name and whether you need raw logs or redacted samples? Also, do you require notarized attestations or is a signed cover letter sufficient for this intake?

I'll follow up with Karthik + Marissa internally and send a consolidated package.

Best,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Aurora CAIQ — evidence inventory and minimal artifacts

Grace / Marissa — looping in my notes for what we'll provide for Aurora. This is internal only; we'll reply to Megan once we've staged the artifacts.

Scope confirmation: hosted API (no private deployment), region = us-west-2, production tenant = aurora-prod (confirmed on the call).

Suggested artifact set (minimal):
1) redwood-caiq-crosswalk-v1.xlsx — mapping of CCM id -> Redwood answer + artifact reference (policy.x, config.y).
2) Policy PDF: data-retention-policy-v2.1.pdf — highlights retention for hosted customers.
3) IdP config snapshot: okta-app-aurora-prod.json (export stub) or a screenshot: okta-sso-config.png.
4) Key management proof: kms-rotation-log-202602.txt (rotation timestamps + key IDs masked) and our KMS architecture diagram (kms-arch.pdf).
5) Runtime sample: inference-logs-20260215-redacted.log (redacted request ids, showing tenant isolation markers).

Notes on format/upload:
- Prefer secure Google Drive folder (shared link with expiry) for artifacts smaller than 50MB.
- For logs that contain PII/sensitive tokens, we must provide redacted extracts only; we will include a short redaction statement.
- I'll produce short README entries in the crosswalk that point to exact file names and control mappings.

I'll assemble redwood-caiq-crosswalk-v1.xlsx today and attach to our outbound. Marissa, can you create the Drive folder with expiration and set uploader permissions for me + Grace?

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

What we delivered:
- redwood-caiq-crosswalk-v1.xlsx (attached) — control-by-control mapping for the CCM sections you requested, with a short narrative per control and artifact pointers.
- Sample artifacts in secure Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAurora-CAIQ (link expires 2026-04-01)
  - data-retention-policy-v2.1.pdf
  - kms-rotation-log-202602.txt (rotation timestamps redacted, key IDs masked)
  - inference-logs-20260215-redacted.log (tenant markers only; no PII)
  - okta-sso-config.png (screenshot)

A few clarifications and ask-back items:
- We included a short redaction statement in the folder README. If your auditors require raw logs with an NDA, we can discuss an alternate transfer.
- For control A2.3 (privileged access reviews), we mapped the artifact to "monthly-privileged-review.csv" which is a synthesized view for sample purposes; full audit reports are only available under an executed DPA addendum.

Attachments: redwood-caiq-crosswalk-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 78KB), saml-assertion-sample.txt (text/plain, 4KB)
